## Checklist

- [ ] Focused change; `.proto` and both codegen sides updated together (if contracts changed)
- [ ] `make build` is green
- [ ] `make test` is green
- [ ] Lint/format pass (`cargo clippy -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `go vet`)
- [ ] Added/updated tests
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know (trade-offs, follow-ups, calibration TODOs).
